title: pigea indica
intro: Pigea indica, commonly known as Neem, is a tropical evergreen tree native to the Indian subcontinent, belonging to the Meliaceae family. The Neem tree is a rich source of health benefits, including its ability to prevent and treat various skin infections and diseases, such as acne, eczema, and psoriasis, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Neem include nimbin, nimnodal, and nimic acid, which exhibit therapeutic actions like immunomodulation, antiviral, and antifungal properties. The Neem tree has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, and its extracts have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and wound-healing properties.
